label: Quest
description: A Sealed Crate is a turn-in task involving recovered trade goods that have fallen into the hands of highwaymen or were lost along commercial routes.…
intro: A Sealed Crate is a turn-in task involving recovered trade goods that have fallen into the hands of highwaymen or were lost along commercial routes. Adventurers return intercepted cargo to trade handlers to secure regional supply lines and receive payment.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you for your hard work, friend. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates lying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
